title: Animated Beverage Station Timeline Editor
description: The user controls an animated beverage preparation station where a WaterBottle pours into a CoffeeMug along a choreographed timeline. The InterpolationTest model serves as a visual interpolation reference panel showing easing curves in real-time. Users keyframe object positions, rotations, and pour-fill levels across a multi-track timeline, with undo/redo support and conservation of liquid volume between bottle and mug.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an animated beverage station timeline editor. Load WaterBottle.glb, InterpolationTest.glb, and coffeeMug.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the CoffeeMug on a table-like plane at center, the WaterBottle above-right, and the InterpolationTest model to the left as a reference dashboard. Use OrbitControls for camera interaction, starting at position (0, 3, 5) looking at origin. Add ambient light (0.4) and a directional light from (5,8,3) with intensity 1.0 and shadow mapping enabled on the ground plane. Implement a bottom-screen HTML timeline UI with 10 seconds of playback divided into keyframe slots. Users click on the WaterBottle or CoffeeMug to select them, then set keyframes for position (x,y,z) and rotation (z-axis tilt) at the current timeline cursor via an Add Keyframe button. A fill-level slider (0-100%) controls how full the mug appears using a scaled cyan cylinder inside it. Enforce a conservation law: the bottle fill plus mug fill must always equal 100%. Changing one automatically adjusts the other. Animate the InterpolationTest model's built-in animations synchronized to the timeline playhead to visualize interpolation modes. Provide play/pause, scrub, and speed (0.5x, 1x, 2x) controls. Implement full undo/redo with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z supporting at least 20 history states for keyframe additions, deletions, and fill-level changes. Interpolate between keyframes using THREE.AnimationMixer with custom AnimationClips built from user keyframes using CatmullRom interpolation. Highlight the selected object with an emissive outline. The timeline tracks should show colored dots per keyframe per object. Minimum interaction steps: select bottle, add 3 keyframes for tilt-pour motion, select mug, add 2 keyframes for position, adjust fill levels at 3 points respecting conservation, use undo once, then play the full animation.
